summary.text: Heather Berghmans is a Democrat who has served in the New Mexico Senate since 2025, representing District 15 in Bernalillo County.
Berghmans is vice chair of the Senate Tax, Business and Transportation Committee and also sits on the Senate Rules Committee.

paragraphs.text: Berghmans's legislative page lists a district office in Albuquerque.
Between sessions, Berghmans chairs the Science, Technology and Telecommunications Committee and is a member of the Revenue Stabilization and Tax Policy Committee.
